editorial.blurb: Casual taqueria known for exceptional birria tacos that rival specialized spots, with a full bar and daily specials.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the quesobirria tacos and ask for extra broth on the side for dipping—arrive during off-peak hours (before 11am or mid-afternoon) for a quieter experience, and note that an automatic 18% gratuity is added to dine-in bills.
